character.locked_description: Maya is a 9-year-old South Asian girl with a slender build, warm brown skin, a round face, and dark curly hair tied high on her head. She wears a teal windbreaker (#2A9D8F), black fingerless gloves, dark denim jeans, and orange sneakers (#F4A261). A small adjustable wrench hangs from a bright orange lanyard around her neck. She sits upright with an active, forward-leaning posture in a lightweight manual wheelchair. The wheelchair features a sleek black frame, bright orange spoke guards (#F4A261), and a compact canvas toolkit strapped securely under the seat.
